after.excerpt: The Kingdom of Tungning (), or the Kingdom of Formosa, was a dynastic state that ruled part of southwestern Formosa (Taiwan) between 1661 and 1683. It was founded by Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) as part of the loyalist movement to restore the Ming dynasty on the Chinese mainland after its rump state in southern China was overthrown by the Manchu-led Qing dynasty. Koxinga hoped to recapture the mainland China from the Qing, using the island as a base of operations. Until its annexation by the Qing dynasty in 1683, the Kingdom was ruled by Koxinga's heirs, the House of Koxinga . Names In reference to its reigning dynasty, the Kingdom of Tungning is sometimes known as the Zheng dynasty (), Zheng Family Kingdom () or Kingdom of Yanping () . Taiwan was referred to by Koxinga as Tungtu (). In the West , it was known as the Kingdom of Taiwan, and the period of rule is sometimes referred to as the Koxinga dynasty.
